reading.action: Refuse the safe vent. Channel the overfilled siphoned flame INTO his own flesh — muscle and bone — to scour weakness and temper himself like a blade. (Insight: the System blocks growth-by-exercise, but honors costly transformation.)

partA_temper.note: WILL controls the fire well (margin 12 clears DC -> no loss of control, no crack-to-bone, no crippling injury); but roll 6 = CRUDE precision, and VIT 7 (low) makes his body the weak link -> it burns far more than it tempers. Roll-6 outcome = path opens + survives, heavy harm, NO attribute (that needed the 13+ clean-thread band).

reading.result: It WORKS — barely — and it hurts. He holds control (margin 12): the fire goes where he wills it, into muscle and bone, and does NOT crack toward bone or maim him. But the scour is crude (roll 6) and his low VIT means the forging sears more than it hardens. PROOF OF PATH (the real prize): a body CAN be forged this way — the insight is validated, growth-by-transformation is real where growth-by-reps is walled. SKILL EMERGED: 'Ember-Tempered Body' (Novice 1) — forging the flesh with ember-essence to scour weakness; future ranks / cleaner tempers grant real physical resilience (and, on a strong thread, attribute gains). This crude first temper grants the PATH, not yet a stat (no +VIT, no maxHP change this attempt). OVERFILL RESOLVED: the stored excess heat that was scalding him is SPENT constructively into the temper — he is no longer brim-full / cooking from within. NO affinity tick (transformation of his own held heat, not absorption from a source -> Ember Manipulation stays 4). COST: HP 66 -> 42 (-24, the forging sears him; control kept it from being worse), Focus 82 -> 72 (-10 willed direction), Stamina 47 -> 41 (-6 the ordeal). STILL MID-FIGHT: Sentinel jammed in the stairmouth above, the stair still heating (external oven persists); Burning Anger up at the lip; Cold Revenge in hand; the seam still drainable. STOP at his decision point — hardened-but-hurt, HP under half, his move. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
